name: Route the Payment
brief: Route every payment through the cheaper provider until the queue is empty.
context: YamusaPay has two payment providers online. Each costs a small fee per payment.
narrative: A payment queue is filling up. Two providers, A and B, are both online and reliable — the only difference is the fee they charge. The routing engine you are authoring must choose a provider for each payment. Pick the cheaper one and clear the queue.
objective: Process every payment through the cheapest provider with no failures.
learningObjective: Filtering and basic decision: read a fact about each option and choose by one criterion (fee).
intelligenceExplanation: The engine hands you one payment at a time at the head of the queue. The provider cards show that B is cheaper in this fixed scenario. Make B your preferred route while it is online. The run completes when every payment has been processed.
hints: Watch the queue on the right — each tick shows the payment at the head and each provider's fee.
A payment needs a routing rule: WHEN onlineB → DO route-b.
That single rule clears the queue, because B stays online and is the cheaper provider here.

steps.hint: Route every payment until none are waiting.
